sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act further to amend the
Punjab Urban Immovable Properly Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 12th July, 1990]
No. Legis. 2(28)/89/134, dated
12-7-1990: -The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill, 1989,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 28th day of
June, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 12th day of
July, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Pubjab.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Act, 1990.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the day of July,
1989.

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax Amendment Act 1990
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Act V of 1958

ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
PUNJAB URBAN IMMOVABLE PROPERTY TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1990
An Act further to amend the
Punjab Urban Immovable Properly Tax Act, 1958
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 12th July, 1990]
No. Legis. 2(28)/89/134, dated
12-7-1990: -The Punjab Urban Immovable Property Tax (Amendment) Bill, 1989,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on the 28th day of
June, 1990 and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on the 12th day of
July, 1990, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Pubjab.
2. Amendment of section 4 of Act V of 1958.--In the Punjab Urban
Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (V of 1958), in section 4, after clause (g),
the following new clause (gg) shall be added:-
"(gg) one residential house owned, and occupied for his
residence by a retired Government servant;"
